items: DISCONNECT COLD START FUEL HOSE FROM DELIVERY PIPE
REMOVE COLD START INJECTOR FROM AIR INTAKE CHAMBER

content.text: 1. MEASURE RESISTANCE OF COLD START INJECTOR
Using an ohmmeter, check the resistance of the injector.

content.description: Illustration showing ohmmeter connected to cold start injector terminals for resistance measurement

content.text: 2. CHECK INJECTION OF COLD START INJECTOR

items.label: (a)
items.text: Install the gasket, SST (two unions), another gaskets and two union bolts to the delivery pipe and injector.

items.label: (b)
items.text: Connect the SST (hose) from the unions.

items.label: (c)
items.text: Connect the SST (wire) to the injector.

content.text: Position the injector as far away from the battery as possible.

items.label: (d)
items.text: Put a container under the injector.

items.label: (f)
items.text: Short both terminals of the fuel pump check connector with a service wire.

content.description: Illustration showing SST hose connected from unions to container, with wire connection to battery and injector setup for testing fuel spray

items.label: (g)
items.text: Connect the test probes of the SST to the battery and check that the fuel spray is as shown.

content.text: Perform this check within the shortest possible time.

items.label: (h)
items.text: Disconnect the test probes from the battery and check that fuel does not leak from the injector.

content.text: Fuel drop: Less than one drop of fuel per minute

content.description: Illustration showing SST disconnected from battery and injector setup to check for fuel leakage

items.label: (i)
items.text: After checking, restore the following to the previous state.
